title: Hook Plan
description: Per-candidate hook plan written into the creative contract (Design_Review_2026-08-22.md P1-1). Records what happens in the first 1-1.5s, the first audible information, the promise, the real evidence that backs it, and how this candidate differs from sibling candidates. Everything is natural language for the review board.

hook_window_seconds.description: [start, end] of the hook window, e.g. [0, 1.5]

first_frame_visual.description: 前 1-1.5 秒画面发生什么（自然语言）

first_audio.description: 第一听觉信息：口播第一句 / 音效 / 音乐起势

promise.description: 钩子承诺解决什么问题

proof_evidence.description: 用哪条真实证据兑现承诺（引用研究矩阵行/自有素材）

difference.description: 本候选钩子与其他候选的差异（自然语言）
